thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Traffic anomaly detected for cluster: api-gateway-prod. 5xx rate on /v1/generate = 5.8% (baseline 0.3%). Possible source: recent LB/Envoy route priority rollout. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:

harper: Got it, I'm oncall. Paging @sri for infra lead. Any recent route config changes on gateway?

sri: I saw a config rollout earlier at 09:12 UTC that adjusted route priorities for weight-based spillover between svc-gen-v1 and svc-gen-v2. I flagged it but QA passed. I’ll pull the rollout diff.

evan: I can grab envoy logs & metrics. Quick check — hitting the VIP returns 502 consistently when concurrency > 8. curl example: `for i in {1..20}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate & done` -> sees bunch of 502/503.

carla: I'm on the rollout. We changed route priority to push 30% traffic to svc-gen-v2 for canary then auto-evict to 0% if errors. Looks like the spillover logic used a `priority` field we updated. I’ll attach the snippet I applied:

```
# applied via infractl routes apply
- route: /v1/generate
  weighted_clusters:
    - name: svc-gen-v1
      weight: 70
    - name: svc-gen-v2
      weight: 30
  policy:
    priority: spillover
    retry_policy:
      num_retries: 2
      per_try_timeout: 2s
```

maya: Noting: increasing retry_policy + spillover makes a small failure in v2 amplify on v1 via backpressure. Could be retry storms + circuit-breaker tripping.

harper: Action plan: 1) Disable retries at gateway to stop amplification 2) Revert route weights to 100% v1 (rollback canary) 3) Temporarily relax circuit-breaker thresholds to avoid hard ejecting upstream while we investigate 4) Paging SRE if not resolved in 15m.

sri: Agreed. I'll do (1) and (2) now. Applying a quick patch to gateway envoy config: `kubectl -n gateway exec -it gateway-0 -- envoyctl config update -f /tmp/gw-no-retries.yaml` with content:

```
route_config:
  name: api_routes
  virtual_hosts:
    - name: api
      routes:
        - match: /v1/generate
          route:
            cluster: svc-gen
            retry_policy: null  # remove retries
```

leo: I’m going to bump cluster circuit breaker to avoid ejecting at first sign. command: `infractl cluster set-upstream svc-gen --max-connections=2000 --max-pending=500 --max-retries=0`

carla: Rolling route weight back to v1: `infractl route set-weight /v1/generate svc-gen-v1=100 svc-gen-v2=0 --reason="emergency rollback"`

harper: Deployment ops looking good. Can we get quick smoke from loadgen?

evan: Running load test 100qps for 3m now. Initial 5xx at start of run ~5.8%. After disabling retries + rollback I see 5xx drop to 0.9% within 90s. Latency P95 improved from 680ms -> 210ms.

incident-bot: NOTE: PagerDuty escalation suppressed by manual ack.

maya: Confirming metrics in Datadog: error budget burn stopped. There’s a short spike correlated to retry queue backs up on svc-gen-v2 nodes causing 502 from proxy. Root cause hypothesis: the spillover priority + nonzero retries created retry amplification and the v2 nodes had slightly less capacity (OOM GC flaps) causing cascade.

harper: Handing off to @sri for deeper root cause & postmortem. I’ll stay on the thread for 10m then sign off. If anything regresses, escalate.

sri: Taking lead. Immediate mitigation done. Next steps: 1) collect envoy config diffs 2) gather svc-gen-v2 pod logs for OOM/GC/noisy neighbor 3) run controlled canary with traffic shaping and no retries. I’ll open a follow-up ticket.

carla: Created incident ticket INC-3456 and linked the config diff. Will also export `envoy config dump` and attach.

leo: Note to infra team: we should change default for canary spillover -> do not enable retries on gateway-level by default. Also add a safeguard that canary cluster capacity must be >= X before auto-weighting.

harper: Any customer-facing impact? Support, please advise.

maya: Preliminary: about 1.4k requests over a 12m window returned 5xx, affecting 0.02% of total traffic. No major customer reports yet; CS alerted and monitoring is on.

evan: Attaching quick debugging commands used: `kubectl -n prod logs svc-gen-v2-abc --timestamps | grep -E "OOM|error|timeout"` and `kubectl -n gateway exec gateway-0 -- curl -svS localhost:15000/config_dump`

sri: I’ll run a controlled canary later with `infractl canary run --route /v1/generate --to svc-gen-v2 --rate 1% --no-retries` and collect perf.

harper: Thanks team. If the metrics stay healthy for 30m I’ll mark as mitigated and create a postmortem outline.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated (temporary rollback + retry disable). Ops lead: sri. Severity: Sev2 -> monitoring.

carla: Post-incident action items added to INC-3456: 1) revert risky automatic spillover policy 2) add pre-rollout capacity checks 3) add circuit-breaker and retry interplay docs 4) schedule retrospective.

sri: Postmortem draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3456 (will update with timeline and root cause analysis).

harper: Signing off from oncall now — handing to night shift. If anything pops, page SRE L2. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maya: Follow-up note: recommend a short-runbook entry "Canary spillover + retries" with safe defaults.

leo: Logged a follow-up RFC to infra backlog: safer canary policies + automatic retry gating.

harper: Thread closed once postmortem published. Good job team.
